items.html: There is also another phase, that these Mochin, in the phase of their lights, are two phases: one is the internal Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama, as mentioned; and there are also surrounding Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama from outside, on top of the three phases that there are in the vessels, as mentioned. It was also explained there that the garments, which are on the part of Yeshsut, are empty vessels without lights of their own, and within them are only the lights of the Mochin of ZA. And behold, all these phases apply both in the phase of the pregnancy, in the phase of the nursing, and in the phase of the Mochin of Gadlut.
